name: Deccan Polypacks Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Deccan Polypacks Ltd manufactures polypropylene woven bags and polyethylene woven sacks
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
a) PP/HDPE Woven Sacks/Bags from 45 Cm to 120 Cm in Tubular.
b) PP/HDPE Bags/Sacks up to 200 Cm Width in Side Stitching.
c) PP/LDPE Lamination of Sacks Internal/ Out Side Possible.
d) PP Sheets up to A width of 220 Cm Un-Laminated 
e) Ground Cover Cloth (Black)PP Sheets/Rolls from 60 to 90 GSM.
f) HDPE Tarpaulin Sheets in Different Shades, Sizes and Design Made to Order
g) HMHD/LDPE/LLDPE Liner Bags for Shopping/Garbage in Different Shades

cons: Promoters have pledged or encumbered 26.4% of their holding.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -38.1%
